verdicts.note: The paper emphasizes microbands and deformation twins at higher strains, but does not establish that stacking faults cease to be important or that these mechanisms are dominant; dislocation–stacking-fault interactions are still observed at 35% strain.

The Ho alloy shows localized interfacial deformation and little B2 dislocation activity, but the paper does not state that stacking faults were evaluated and rejected as its primary accommodation mechanism.
